question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a6b10d63da5603e307cbe56215545d6116e7fa547bb60117e293c8d1ae3cf70.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: One arc flips from outward to inward in each consecutive step, moving **clockwise** from the top-right.

So far, the top-right, right-middle, and bottom-right arcs have flipped.

The next figure will flip the **bottom-left** arc inward, continuing the clockwise pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fe226dd5e617dc1e157e90469611319250bafe393249fc1e7c81c75e80cc6e6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
